title: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis — NIPA Handbook, Chapter 2: Fundamental Concepts (updated December 2024)
use: Production boundaries, value added and expenditure/income reconciliation; gross/net and domestic/national distinctions; GDP–GDI statistical discrepancy; scoped real and command-basis income terminology. All chapter ledgers, examples and exercises are original.
verification: Retrieved actual official 31-page PDF and inspected PDF pages 1–17: production and asset boundaries; market/nonmarket/imputations; intermediate versus final uses and imported content; income components; value added; gross/net and domestic/national measures; GDP–GDI discrepancy and measured GNI bridge; price/quantity and command-basis measures. No current release values or historical source numerical examples are imported.
